purpose: To celebrate Pride Month, showcase LGBTQIA+ artists from the VALORANT community, and provide codes for in-game Pride-themed items.
summary: The article celebrates Pride Month in the VALORANT community by featuring stories and artwork from LGBTQIA+ artists. It highlights their experiences and connections to the game, emphasizing the importance of representation and community support. Additionally, it provides codes for players to redeem new in-game Pride-themed items like a title, spray, and player cards.
